release: OculoStudio v0.21.59 — Aligned Ego Video + TSD + FaceMapper Export

environment.note: The Windows desktop shell and batch installer require final confirmation on the user’s Windows machine. The packaged web UI was rendered in Chromium against a live FastAPI project through an in-process HTTP relay.

contracts.video: clean CFR H.264/MP4, no QC slate or scientific overlay; explicit frame map required
contracts.audio: optional source audio from the exact Native interval
contracts.tsd: byte-identical copy from verified TSD_trimmed.zip, SHA-256 checked
contracts.facemapper: byte-identical copy from verified FaceMapper_trimmed.zip, SHA-256 checked
contracts.role_isolation: independent R01/R02 parent trims, artifacts and output paths

limitations: Synthetic fixtures validate timing, packaging, frame mapping, checksum preservation and UI wiring; the user’s real full-length MP4 export is computed on the Windows project after installation.
Windows WebView2 and the one-click BAT installer were not executed in this Linux validation environment.
